evidence.task: Run Codex non-interactively from a copied, non-git benchmark workspace.
observations: Codex 0.141.0 failed before the task because gpt-5.6-sol requires a newer Codex build.
The copied workspace first failed the trust check until --skip-git-repo-check was supplied.
The desktop-bundled 0.145.0-alpha.27 binary plus --skip-git-repo-check completed the exact file assertion.
The immutable production database SHA-256 remained unchanged.

queries: codex exec fails because gpt-5.6-sol requires a newer Codex version
automation in copied workspace says not inside a trusted directory
which Codex binary should local benchmark automation use
consumerQuery: Codex automation in a copied workspace fails on the model version and repository trust check
consumerTask: Create solution.json with the Codex executable and arguments that the verified automation should use.

decoys.title: Upgrade Node for Codex
decoys.situation: codex command fails after a Node runtime upgrade
decoys.body: Switch the shell to Node 22 and reinstall the npm package.

decoys.title: Trust repository globally
decoys.situation: codex refuses to run inside a normal git checkout
decoys.body: Add the repository to the global trust list and keep using the Homebrew binary.

evidence.task: Make BullMQ flow jobs retry and retain jobs like normal Queue.add jobs.
observations: The Queue instance was configured with defaultJobOptions attempts=3, exponential backoff delay=1000, removeOnComplete=100, and removeOnFail=1000.
Jobs added through FlowProducer.add still had attempts=1.
FlowProducer creates flow jobs directly and does not read another Queue instance's defaultJobOptions.
Passing the shared options explicitly to the parent opts and every child opts produced attempts=3 and the expected retention values.
ignoreDependencyOnFailure belongs on child opts when a failed child must not block the parent.
verifiedBy: BullMQ job options read back from Redis

queries: BullMQ FlowProducer jobs ignore Queue defaultJobOptions and do not retry
how to give flow parents and children the same attempts backoff retention
failed BullMQ child blocks parent despite ignore dependency setting
consumerQuery: FlowProducer jobs use one attempt even though the Queue has retry defaults
consumerTask: Create solution.json describing the required parent and child BullMQ options.

decoys.title: Queue defaults live Redis
decoys.situation: BullMQ workers do not see queue default job options
decoys.body: Queue defaultJobOptions are persisted in Redis, so restart every Worker.

decoys.title: Flow retries on parent
decoys.situation: BullMQ FlowProducer child jobs do not retry
decoys.body: Set attempts and backoff only on the parent; children inherit the parent opts.
